marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to south 15 knots after midnight and to
south 25 early Friday morning. Scattered flurries ending near noon
Friday. Low tonight minus 6. High Friday minus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 2 near noon
Friday.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Saturday: Wind south 25 knots diminishing to south 15
 in the morning.<br/>Sunday: Wind northwest 10 to 15 knots becoming
